niches.name: Girl-next-door / natural-relatable
niches.one_liner: "A real girl you could actually meet" — attainability is the product
niches.fit_note: cheapest to execute, but saturated; works best as the *base* under a differentiator
niches.voice: chatty, self-deprecating, ♡ and 🥺, soft coded CTAs
niches.visual: natural light, phone selfies, bedroom/kitchen/car, minimal retouching
niches.audience: broad male 20–45 buying accessibility and responsiveness
niches.hybrids: any trait or lifestyle niche; GFE as the DM layer
cf_angles: "only you guys see this" home-routine tease

niches.name: Glamour / bombshell
niches.one_liner: polished, editorial, aspirational — the feed is the magazine cover, CF is the outtakes
niches.fit_note: needs shoot budget and a model look
niches.visual: studio/luxury settings, pro lighting, lingerie/designer styling, glossy grid

niches.name: Alt / goth / tattooed (punk, emo, grunge sub-variants)
niches.one_liner: dark, modded, visually unmistakable — every frame reads as goth without a caption
niches.fit_note: the niche punishes tourists; mods are unfakeable authenticity
niches.visual: black/deep-red/purple, tattoos foregrounded, corsetry, platforms, lace/latex
niches.audience: alt-identified men and women; low competition, high search volume

niches.name: Bimbo / Barbie hyper-feminine
niches.one_liner: self-aware maximal femininity — pink, plastic, proud
niches.fit_note: persona must be total; cosmetic investment is real; instantly legible brand
niches.visual: pink-dominant, big blonde hair, gloss, doll/princess props

niches.name: Pin-up / retro / vintage
niches.one_liner: 1940s–60s glamour codes — red lip, victory rolls, gingham — "tasteful" is the sell
niches.fit_note: styling skill required; very low competition; ages well
niches.visual: warm/sepia grading, period wardrobe, burlesque props, classic cars
niches.audience: older, higher-spend collectors; burlesque/cosplay fandom overlap
cf_angles: retro homemaking interlude (baking in the look)

niches.name: Girlfriend experience (GFE)
niches.one_liner: "your online girlfriend" — the product is the relationship, not the photo. **This is the default CF operating model for every niche.**
niches.fit_note: zero production cost; the constraint is DM stamina and emotional consistency
niches.visual: deliberately intimate and low-production — the grid looks like a partner's camera roll
niches.audience: men paying for attention and continuity; retention-driven
cf_angles: "if you were here right now…" POV

niches.name: Profession persona ("uniform niche")
niches.one_liner: a real (or plausibly real) job as the hook — the secret-double-life narrative is the marketing
niches.fit_note: needs a credible job story; real employment risk
niches.visual: uniform/workwear props, hotel layovers, office settings

niches.name: Femdom / findom / kink-coded
niches.one_liner: power dynamic as brand — "Goddess", tribute language — explicit layer kept off IG. Instagram is this niche's *weakest* channel (it lives on X/Telegram); CF works only for already-committed subs
niches.visual: latex/leather, black-red-purple, throne/crown motifs — or bratty e-girl variant

niches.name: Comedy / personality-first
niches.one_liner: funny first, hot second — the paid page is an extension of a comedic persona
niches.fit_note: requires a genuine comedic voice; un-copyable once it lands
niches.voice: the voice IS the brand; no aesthetic uniformity needed
niches.visual: chaotic selfies, stage clips, memes

niches.name: Southern / country / cowgirl
niches.one_liner: boots, trucks, barns and rodeo — American rural identity as the brand
niches.fit_note: location and lifestyle can't be faked; very strong conversion
niches.visual: denim, boots, hats, sundresses; golden-hour fields, tailgates, rodeo
niches.hybrids: fitness, MILF ("country mama"), glam, trad-wife flavor

niches.name: Stoner / 420
niches.one_liner: cannabis lifestyle — glass, smoke, munchies — with the paid page behind the link
niches.fit_note: platform-restricted content; backup account mandatory; loyal community
niches.visual: green/haze palette, glass and trays, tie-dye/thrift, lo-fi bedroom light

niches.name: Outdoorsy / nature / van-life
niches.one_liner: landscapes, camping, yoga on rocks — free-spirit sensuality
niches.fit_note: needs location access; very low competition; doubles as a shoot portfolio
niches.visual: earth tones, golden hour, desert/forest, film-look grading
niches.audience: art-nude and nature-photo buyers; older, higher spend

niches.name: Beach / surf / bikini
niches.one_liner: endless-summer bikini content where the "VIP" is the point
niches.fit_note: easy to produce, hard to differentiate; pair with a trait or persona
niches.visual: sun-bleached warmth, sand/boat/pool, micro-bikinis, wet hair
niches.audience: broad male; crowded with non-adult bikini influencers

niches.name: MILF / mature (35+)
niches.one_liner: age and motherhood ARE the brand — confident, unapologetic
niches.fit_note: authenticity is the moat; low competition, premium pricing
niches.visual: polished consistent grid, home and everyday settings, presence over filters
niches.hybrids: comedy, country ("country mama"), goth ("goth mom"), muscle-mommy fitness

niches.name: Trait-as-brand (redhead/ginger; height; freckles)
niches.one_liner: one physical trait, named in the handle, repeated everywhere
niches.fit: High as a *modifier*, low as a whole identity
niches.fit_note: cheap durable differentiation if the trait is real
niches.voice: inherits the host niche; palette chosen to flatter the trait; "all-natural / certified" claims
niches.visual: inherits the host niche; palette chosen to flatter the trait; "all-natural / certified" claims
niches.audience: search-driven trait devotees (redhead is the best-evidenced)

niches.name: Fitness-forward
niches.one_liner: gym/athlete content **with** an adult funnel — visually identical to fitness influencers, structurally different
niches.fit_note: needs a genuine physique and training habit; usually runs a clean main + spicy alt
niches.voice: training talk that slides into tease
niches.visual: gym mirror, physique checks, meal prep, competition/bikini content
niches.audience: physique buyers converting from fitness following
niches.hybrids: country, muscle-mommy MILF, male gym-bro, gymnast/athlete persona

niches.name: Trans creators
niches.one_liner: identity stated up front; the social profile is the authenticity layer fans check before subscribing
niches.fit_note: lower competition, highest LTV in agency data; higher moderation/harassment load
niches.visual: inherits a host niche (fitness, cosplay/gamer, GND); face-forward consistency matters more than for cis niches

niches.name: Male creators (gym-bro, twink, himbo, performer)
niches.one_liner: male adult brand carried by physique, a viral persona, or an explicit industry affiliation
niches.fit_note: smaller market, predominantly gay-male audience; needs a standout body or hook
niches.visual: shirtless gym (bro), slim editorial (twink), viral-clip energy (himbo), agency polish (performer)

niches.name: E-girl / cosplay / gamer
niches.one_liner: anime, gaming and costume craft as identity; conventions as proof-of-work
niches.fit_note: craft and cost are real; the community pre-exists and rewards skill
niches.visual: pastel/neon or dark-alt, wigs and builds, RGB rooms, SFX makeup
niches.audience: gaming/anime fandom; e-girl × cosplay is the highest-leverage stack
niches.hybrids: alt/goth, streamer, trans, "your anime gf" GFE

niches.name: Streamer crossover
niches.one_liner: the only niche where the audience exists before the paid page — CF is the "chat can't see this" tier
niches.visual: stream-setup aesthetics carried into daily life

niches.name: Musician / DJ / artist crossover
niches.one_liner: a real music identity with the paid page as "exclusive access" — rarely works bottom-up
niches.visual: stage/festival/studio, rave styling
